import numpy as np
import os
from PIL import Image
_p = 'branding/host_jose.png'
if not os.path.exists(_p):
    _p = '/home/jose/tiktok/branding/host_jose.png'
f = np.asarray(Image.open(_p).convert('RGB')).mean(axis=2)
cara = f[400:640, 280:520]
bordes = np.array([[0,1,0],[1,-4,1],[0,1,0]], dtype=float)
def conv(m, k):
    a = m.shape[0]-2; b = m.shape[1]-2
    s = np.zeros((a,b))
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(3):
            s += k[i,j]*m[i:i+a, j:j+b]
    return np.abs(s)
salida = conv(cara, bordes)
plano = round(float(np.median(salida[:60, :60])))
borde = round(float(np.percentile(salida, 99.5)))
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9.4, 4.8))
axs[0].imshow(cara, cmap='gray'); axs[0].set_title('mi cara', fontsize=21)
axs[1].imshow(salida, cmap='inferno'); axs[1].set_title('lo que responde', fontsize=21)
for ax in axs:
    ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
axs[0].set_xlabel('zona plana: %d' % plano, color=GREEN, fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', labelpad=14)
axs[1].set_xlabel('en el borde: %d' % borde, color=MAG, fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', labelpad=14)
